basic_info.description: Welcome to this rarely available 2-bedroom, 2-bath luxury condominium, ideally situated in a boutique 2013 elevator building along the vibrant Valencia Corridor. Freshly painted and thoughtfully designed, this stylish home boasts an open-concept layout with expansive double-pane Bonelli windowsperfect for both everyday comfort and entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted with custom cabinetry, a Bertazzoni range, Bosch dishwasher, and sleek Caesarstone countertops. Both bathrooms offer a spa-like retreat, featuring heated floors for added luxury. Enjoy high-end touches throughout, including Kahrs hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, an in-unit washer and dryer, gas fireplace, and a private balcony. The unit is positioned at the quiet rear south side of the building, offering exceptional privacy and tranquility. An independent garage parking space adds further convenience. Unwind on the shared rooftop deck with sweeping panoramic views from Downtown to Twin Peaks. With perfect Walk, Bike, and Transit Scores of 100, you're steps from everything: Whole Foods, top-rated restaurants, cafes, nightlife, Dolores Park, and easy access to BART and highways 80/101.  This is a rare opportunity to own a modern, sophisticated home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
